Involvement

Act One

See Lump the Enlightened for a detailed guide of this interaction.

Fank is in the ruined schoolhouse of the Blighted Village with his companions  Chock and  Lump the Enlightened. The trio are feasting on a  Dead Tiefling. If the party approach, the ogres ask the party to show a Brand of the Absolute from  Priestess Gut. If the interacting party member is not branded, they must convince the ogres not to attack. On success, the party can also convince the ogres to work for them instead of the Absolute, which leads Lump to relinquish  Lump's War Horn.
